Chief Justice Declines Comment on Election Commission Protests

Chief Justice of India D.Y. Chandrachud stated that issues concerning protests and restrictions in Delhi, as well as matters related to the Election Commission, were "not his domain." He made these remarks in response to queries about the ongoing protests.
